臺灣總督府統計書 1897

Taiwan Sōtokufu tōkeisho, 第一 (No. 1), 明治三十年 (Meiji 30)
臺灣總督府民政部文書課, 1899

All 168 numbered tables are transcribed, together with the printed contents. Tables printed across both pages of a spread, or read in sections by different readers, are joined into one. The tables were read by Opus sub-agents from enlarged crops, a few of the last ones by Opus 5.5 through the API and by the orchestrating session; there was no second reading. Printed totals were re-added: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted in the table. Where the only doubt was how stacked 一/二/三 strokes group and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Small figures for concurrent post-holders (兼務, marked △ or ×) are written after the main figure, e.g. 372 (△8, ×38). 87 of some 70,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?].
